scope: Selector comes from a scalar CFG assignment. Original modules and temporal properties. Six graph configurations with final independent TLC counts; no claim of a golden for the original ambient-input row.
settings: Both Core profiles, one worker, fp 0, seed 0. Independent pinned TLC on the same CFG in an isolated environment with GRAPH=7. Oracle tlc-2026.10.06.014338 with pinned CommunityModules/deps overrides. No host grant to Core.
reproduce: Copy TestMCReachability.cfg, append CONSTANT GraphName = "1" (or the chosen graph), and run the original TestMCReachability.tla with that configuration. See docs/user/checking.md.

graph_seven.input: 50-vertex graph. TLC uses the released CFG with GRAPH=7. Core appends CONSTANT GraphName = "7" to bind the same graph. Both retain Termination then Live in the released order.

core_final_only.platform: EC2 c7i.4xlarge, eight physical cores available, ordered capture used one worker.
core_final_only.command: dive check TestMCReachability.tla --config ClosedSeven.cfg --library-path modules --workers 8 --compat=tlc --seed 0 --fp 0 --time-limit 3600s --max-memory 18g --output json
core_final_only.stop: DIVE-L0038: stopped during graph-capture: resident memory 19619319808 bytes exceeds the ceiling of 19327352832 bytes

workers.reason: the temporal capture has effects or runtime names (start-up or configured effects): the core captures the behavior graph in order with one worker

tlc.platform: Same EC2 c7i.4xlarge, 8 workers, 14 GiB Java heap, seed 0, fp 0.

invalid_control.edit: Set done=TRUE in the initial state of the same word.
invalid_control.detail: the first state is outside the independent Init relation

simulation.command: dive simulate TestMCReachability.tla --config closed7.cfg --library-path modules --traces 2048 --depth 120 --keep-traces 0 --time-limit 350s --max-memory 4g --workers N --seed 0 --output json
simulation.validation_command: Extract traces[0].document from the report and pass it to dive validate-trace with the same source, CFG and module path.
